Words we use.

16 TERMS

Engagement Rate

Digital Marketing

Share of an audience that interacts with content — engagements divided by reach. Tracks organic health, kept separate from paid metrics.

Political PR

Political PR

The communications strategy for candidates, parties and officials, run in five phases across an election cycle.

Narrative Engineering

Political PR

Building a campaign’s core message as a story, tested against constituency demographics so voters can retell it.

Opposition Research

Political PR

Systematically gathering an opponent’s record and likely lines of attack, using public, verifiable sources only.

Meta Conversions API (CAPI)

Analytics

Server-to-server sharing of conversion events with Meta, recovering signal lost to iOS restrictions and ad blockers.

ROAS (Return on Ad Spend)

Paid Media

Revenue earned for each unit of ad spend. Read it alongside the new-versus-returning customer split.

CTR (Click-Through Rate)

Paid Media

Clicks as a share of impressions. Signals creative quality; benchmarks vary by placement.

Conversion API

Analytics

A server-to-server protocol used by Meta, Google and TikTok to send conversions directly to ad platforms.

Boosted Post

Paid Media

Paying to extend the reach of a Facebook or Instagram post. Limited targeting; political content still needs authorization.

Ad Authorization

Paid Media

Meta’s identity and in-country location check, required before running political, electoral or social-issue ads.

“Paid for by” Disclaimer

Paid Media

The required label naming who funded a political ad. Applied once registered and shown in the public Ad Library.

Special Ad Category

Paid Media

Meta’s restricted classification for political and social-issue ads, limiting demographic and interest targeting.

Constituency Targeting

Political PR

Focusing paid reach on a specific electoral seat using location and affinity tools within Special Ad Category limits.

Answer Block

SEO

A self-contained 40–60 word answer at the top of a long page that AI engines can quote directly.

AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)

SEO

Structuring pages so answer engines cite them — answer-first prose and structured data.

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

SEO

Making content easy for generative AI to ground answers in: crawlable, dated, plain-language facts.
